shows.description:
A jam-meets-dance-party for women and non-binary improvisors of all levels <3

Lady Jam is a longstanding UCB tradition — a free, inclusive, and welcoming improv jam for UCB students, performers, and fans who identify as women or non-binary! All you have to do is put your name in a bucket, dance with us between sets (or tolerate our dancing), then get on stage with your new improv BFFs.

Totally free, and no reservations needed! Just drop your name in the bucket and BAM — you’re performing, baby! Not ready to jam yet? Come hang! We welcome you any way you want to show up

Hosts: Casey McCormick & Co!

Lineup is subject to change. Ages 17+

shows.excerpt: Looking for a Stand-up Comedy Open Mic that’s a supportive room and always a good time? Look no further than the Ya'll Mic. Whether you’re a seasoned comic, an improvisor who’s always wanted to try standup, or you just decided that today’s
shows.description: Looking for a Stand-up Comedy Open Mic that’s a supportive room and always a good time? Look no further than the Ya'll Mic. Whether you’re a seasoned comic, an improvisor who’s always wanted to try standup, or you just decided that today’s the day for your first open mic (kudos) – The Ya'll Mic is a great venue to workshop your bits. The show is every Tuesday from 5:30pm – 7:30pm. Signup is online and the signup sheet is posted on Facebook & IG on Mondays. The list is emailed out a few hours before the show. Comics get 4 minutes of stage time (and a lifetime of memories.) While all are welcome, the room prioritizes BIPOC, LGBTQ+, and Femme comics. Come laugh with us!

shows.description:
Tomorrow’s headliners, tonight!

Mic Drop is a stand-up comedy open mic and showcase at the UCB Annex featuring rising comics, new material, and surprise sets from some of LA’s funniest performers.

Built around a supportive, comedy-first atmosphere, Mic Drop is a space where comics can take big swings, sharpen their material, and perform in front of a real audience, not just a room full of other comics. Each show features a mix of up-and-coming stand-ups and the unpredictable energy that makes live comedy exciting.

Whether you’re working on your next five minutes or just looking to discover new talent, Mic Drop is where LA comics level up.

Hosted by Deric Brown & Abbey Perez

shows.excerpt: An open mic where comedians can push boundaries, try bold new ideas, and embrace the unpredictable. The comedy laboratory where anything can happen! Every Tuesday, Experimental Mic puts a different spin on the traditional open mic. Every show has its…
shows.description:
An open mic where comedians can push boundaries, try bold new ideas, and embrace the unpredictable.

The comedy laboratory where anything can happen!

Every Tuesday, Experimental Mic puts a different spin on the traditional open mic. Every show has its own theme, challenge, or format, so no two nights are the same.

One week, comedians might be doing crowd work. The next, they could be battling A.I in a joke battle, getting “analyzed” by therapists, or trying a brand-new experiment.

Whether it works perfectly or completely falls apart, that’s part of the fun.

Show: 9:30 PM
Doors & comic sign-ups: 9:00 PM

Each comic gets up to 5 minutes. 15 performance spots available.

Hosted by Deric Brown

shows.description:
A night of improv comedy featuring veteran improvisers Convoy and Hebecky Drysbell.

Convoy was described by Time Out LA as “what can happen when a few players know each other’s brains so well that they function as a very funny one” and was named by LA Weekly as “Best Improv Show” in LA more than once! Collectively, they’ve worked on shows like Reno 911!, Childrens Hospital, Terriers, Key & Peele, Last Week Tonight with Jon Oliver, Drive Share, Billion Dollar Propertie$, The Goldbergs and more. They love squids.

Featuring: Alex Berg, Alex Fernie and Todd Fasen

Hebecky Drysbell are the improv duo best known for their all-time UCB Cagematch record (78-0). They have headlined the Edinburgh Improv Festival, and have been described as sharing an “uncanny chemistry” onstage by LA Weekly. Collectively, they’ve written for SNL, The Tonight Show, Rick and Morty, Key & Peele, and appeared on Whose Line is it Anyway?, Arrested Development, and Orange is the New Black.

Cast: Becky Drysdale and Heather Anne Campbell

shows.description: ***This is a free show, but it is highly recommended to reserve your ticket here to guarantee entry.***** Regarded as one of Chicago's funniest and most promising improv groups of the last decade, Dumb John is proud to take the iO Stage with Birdlady in a new weekly long form improv show. Both teams apply their high energy strain of improvisation to a bizarre cultural harvest of small town Americana influence and ephemera, using a single audience suggestion to inspire a piece of unhinged long form improv that propels diesel-soaked characters through fever dream karaoke scenes and down neon aisles of roadside antique marts; exploring the depravity and brilliance found at the heart of every moment. Take flight with two back to back original iO ensembles, Birdlady and Dumb John! Every Wednesday night at 7:30 (FREE), watch as they migrate toward their ultimate destination: hilarious long-form improvisation! It’ll be a HOOT! They’re so funny this show should be Ill-EAGLE! People can’t stop RAVEN about this show! shows.excerpt: True stories about the CIA, Taylor Swift, Kanye West, roller hockey, opium, and the creator of Is It Cake? A washed-up roller hockey goalie gets high and sees a double feature of The Exorcist and Taylor Swift's The Eras Tour…
shows.description:
True stories about the CIA, Taylor Swift, Kanye West, roller hockey, opium, and the creator of Is It Cake?

A washed-up roller hockey goalie gets high and sees a double feature of The Exorcist and Taylor Swift’s The Eras Tour movie. That night leads to an adventure involving Travis Kelce, Kanye West, death threats, becoming the CIA on Instagram, and marrying the creator of Netflix’s hit show Is It Cake? This story seems too outlandish to be true, but he has a PowerPoint full of receipts to prove it.

Mike Glazer is chaotic good. His anarchic, true tales have appeared on Comics Unleashed (CBS), Netflix Is A Joke Festival Presents: Mike Glazer, The F Word with Gordon Ramsay (FOX), High Guys (BuzzFeed), and Worst Cooks in America (Food Network). He also crushed a sold-out arena at the NHL Awards and major festivals, including SXSW and Outside Lands, and is an Emmy-nominated writer for HBO.

shows.description:
The Definitive Celebration of America’s Greatest Minds

Great Americans is the flagship biographical retrospective series of the American Institute of Importance, the nation’s leading nonprofit dedicated to celebrating the figures who shaped this country.

Join Henry Block (The Onion) and some of UCB’s top performers as the Institute inducts a new class of honorees: Scientists. Inventors. Various women in shawls shouting obscenities in public. Through a series of live dramatic presentations, audiences are granted unprecedented access to the lives, legacies, and defining contributions of these essential Americans.

Let us be clear: These are the most important people in our nation’s history. If you haven’t heard of them, you’re being hysterical and no one believes you.

Featuring: Henry Block, Maggie Carr, Harris Solomon, Joey Welsh, Edson Montenegro, and Maddie Groff

Written by Henry Block

shows.description:
The StoryQuest crew tells a chaotic D&D tale where special guests control their fate, as the Dungeon Master changes at the ring of a bell.

Join the StoryQuest crew, Mayanna Berrin (Dispatch, Dungeon Masters), Reed Sights (Webtoon), David Tilstra (From Afar Podcast), Jordy Martin (Pack Theater) and friends for a chaotic Dungeons and Dragons show.

In 75 minutes the StoryQuest crew will take audience suggestions to create a Dungeons and Dragons adventure on the fly, all the while frantically changing which character they’re playing, what podium they’re standing at, and who’s running the show as the Dungeon Master (and everything else) changes each time their hilarious guests rings a bell.

Past Guests have included Johnny Stanton (Dropout), Surena Marie (Dimension 20), and Luis Carazo (Critical Role).

shows.description: Deep in the Nowhere lies The Lost Tavern, a welcoming bar tucked away in a back alley of Obscurity. It is there that our heroes, dedicated cohorts of the Non-dimensional Paragon Cooperative, begin their quests. Join our valiant mercenaries as they set out on adventure and help to shape the story as they pursue good, gold, or glory. This real-play D&D adventure will be pursued by incredible improvisers and comedians, weaving a tale that can only happen once! You, as the audience and patrons of The Lost Tavern, can sit back and enjoy watching it unfold or take a more active hand in helping or hindering our heroes through mini games and interactive elements. Knowledge of the role playing game "Dungeons & Dragons" will enhance your experience, but is not required in order to enjoy the rich telling of a story not yet written.

shows.title: Improv: The Play
shows.excerpt: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never ...
shows.description: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never given a script, and must improvise their way through the scene. The result is a totally original, never before seen piece of theater. It’s drama, it’s comedy, it’s everything that’s magical about theater and improvisation. Come watch this brand-new show at iO and see something you won’t see anywhere else in the city. Featuring: Alex Beard Heather Mari Elijah Sloan Lexi Putter Lucas Pollitzer Marino Korellis Montrez Hawkins Nikk Tetreault Ryan Bowman Shawna Seals Directed by: James Dugan Produced by: Cory Hardin

shows.description: If you’re looking for a date night, girls’ night out, or a mandatory work outing (that your staff will actually like) — Look no further! Fast, funny, and frothy, Thursday Night Improv is entirely improvised and features a different guest opener for veteran iO house team Creamboy every week. Every show is completely different, so you can keep coming back for more! Will you be the lucky audience member to receive the coveted title of Cream of the Week? Creamboy is made up of seasoned Chicago improvisers who play and teach all over the city (and country! And WORLD?!) which means this show is perfect for improv nerds, millennials who love Tina Fey, and even your cousin visiting from Kansas. Comedy so good you'll lick your lips and pat your belly. Mmmm so creamy! Get a taste of Creamboy on Instagram @ creamboy.io

shows.description: Come check out one of Chicago's best longform improv teams, Three Actors Living in a Cave (Ollie Hobson, Mike Brunlieb, and Kyle Bethea) on Thursdays at 9:30pm, 8/20 - 10/8! Joined each week by Lerin (Lauren Frost and Erin Washington) and a rotating guest team! About Three Actors Once upon a time three poor cooks rode upon a huge wooden boat to sail around the world, but it did crash into a coral reef and all 800 aboard were drowned or stung to death except for the three poor cooks. They clung to a floating wardrobe trunk and washed upon the shore of a strange island. There they wandered for seven days and were bitten again and again by poisonous snakes. On the eighth day, tortured by painful fevers, they found refuge in a damp cave where they ate moss and acted out warped little scenarios for one another until they passed away. Their corpses were well preserved by the cool wet cave air and you can visit the island and look at their dead bodies, faces frozen in jest to this very day. shows.title: Blueprint
shows.excerpt: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected ...
shows.description: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected as we build something completely original, live, right before your eyes. Past forms have included: Improvised Severance - Guided by two internal "staff members," three performers are physically out of the room, while three others perform as their innies, and every 5 minutes, the two swapped. Can they make sense of their outies? and versa? Understudies - In a longform narrative, each player on stage knows that they will eventually understudy another player in the show. The lights change and they have to embody a different player, and each time the lights change, they can select another player to embody. Overachiever - Three 2-person monoscenes happen on stage, utilizing the same physical space, but taking place in categorically different spaces. They must navigate space atop of and around one another while keeping connection to their partner. Improvised Heist - Ocean's Eleven, eat your heart out! Our players hit the major plot points of a heist and improvise their way through - initial idea, building the team, planning the heist, executing, and the aftermath Blueprint is joined each week by a lab cast opening for the show with their own unique, original form. Directed by James Dugan Cast: James Dugan Avery Ford Molly Jones Allen Lucas Janelle Soulliere Ryan Bowman

The Very Best Solo Sketch

CABAL combines writer-performers from SNL, The Daily Show, The New Yorker, The Second City, and Just for Laughs into one supergroup delivering the very best in solo sketch comedy. The next big gay pop star? The heroine of the spicy romantasy novel you’re reading? The new Barbie who’s a 6 out of 10? The guy who farts into wine to make it champagne? Any one of them might be in the CABAL.

You’ve seen members of CABAL on Dropout, What We Do in the Shadows, The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel, Search Party, The Tonight Show, The Rehearsal, The Problem with Jon Stewart, Stephen Colbert’s Tooning Out the News, Jimmy Kimmel Live!, Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt, Girls5Eva, High Maintenance, Difficult People, and much more. shows.description: The Improvised Shakespeare Company® proudly presents its critically-acclaimed, long-running hit show Improvised Shakespeare Chicago now in it’s 20th year! Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. Nothing has been planned out, rehearsed, or written. The dialogue is said for the first time, the characters are created as you watch, and if ever you're wondering where the story is going...so are they! You've never seen the Bard like this before! “There’s really nothing quite like it in the city of Chicago. Smart, sophisticated, downright hilarious.” -TimeOut Chicago “…the show channels Monty Python as often as the Bard, and frequently with sly-witted results.” -The Chicago Tribune “Consistently Hilarious” -The Chicago Reader “Staggeringly Brilliant” -TimeOut Chicago “Consistently funny…'Tis v'ry, v'ry good.” -The Chicago Tribune “Indisputably great improv, fueled by smart plot development, stage chemistry and recognizable characters.” -Centerstage Chicago “In short, outstanding.” -TimeOut Chicago Find out more at improvisedshakespeare.com _________________________ Additional option to include Improvised Shakespeare's featured cocktail, Hamlet , with your ticket. It includes Nolets Dry Gin, St-Germaine, Campari, orange juice, and garnished with an orange wedge. Best part? Gratuity is included. Got a Drink Add-on? Follow these steps: Show your ticket to the host and mention the drink add-on. Grab your token and place it on your table. Enjoy your drink as a server will bring it by shortly. Note: Valid ID is required for all alcohol service. No ID, no drink, no refunds.

shows.description:
ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

• “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” -Out Magazine

• “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” -Vice Magazine

—

In-person tickets are $25 plus fees.

Livestream tickets are $10 plus fees. Buyers will receive an email with the livestream link one-hour before the show. Livestream link will be available for 7 days after the show.

All sales are final. The show starts at the time listed. If you are not at the theater more than 5 minutes before the start of the show, we may release your tickets to the waitlist.

shows.excerpt: UCB's weekly improv double header! A night of improv comedy featuring two of LA's top teams performing back-to-back. Get your FIX every FRIDAY. Featuring: THE SMOKES: No gimmicks, no pyrotechnics – just a single suggestion and these friends of (gulp)…
shows.description:
UCB’s weekly improv double header!

A night of improv comedy featuring two of LA’s top teams performing back-to-back. Get your FIX every FRIDAY.

Featuring:

THE SMOKES: No gimmicks, no pyrotechnics – just a single suggestion and these friends of (gulp) twenty years put on an amazing improvised show.

Showbiz credits include: screenwriter of The Heat, co-author of the Broadway musical Beetlejuice, star/co-creator of Playing House, staff writer for Big Mouth, series regular of Superstore, founders of at least two improv schools, voice-over artist in a million cartoons, producer of the hit show Makin’ It, but most relevant: having done improv on stage for 20 years.

Cast: Neil Casey, Katie Dippold, Colton Dunn, Will Hines, Anthony King, Lennon Parham, Joe Wengert, Jim Woods, Chris Kula

THE BIG TEAM (formerly known as White Women) is an improv team of all black men based in Los Angeles. Formed after meeting at the UCB Black History Month Show in 2013, this team has been featured at theaters all over Los Angeles and the country, having headlined festivals in Portland, DC, Austin, NYC, and more.

Collectively they have written and produced videos for Comedy Central, College Humor and Funny or Die, and individually they’ve written and acted in a lot of your favorite TV shows. They were named on Vulture’s annual list of “Comedians You Should and Will Know” in 2018.

Cast: Ronnie Adrian, Zeke Nicholson, Ify Nwadiwe, Ishmel Sahid, Carl Tart, Lamar Woods

Improvisers swap mystery backpacks and justify bizarre props on a chaotic audience chosen trip!

Pack your bags for a no holds barred improvised trip – be it a family reunion, camping trip, or work retreat.

Before the show, each comedian secretly packs a backpack full of strange and random props. The improvisers exchange backpacks onstage at the beginning of the show and then must use and justify why ‘they’ brought each of the various props on the “trip.”

All edible props must be consumed by the unfortunate soul who pulls it out.

shows.description:
An all-ages improv show for kids AND adults featuring UCB’s best improvisers plus a chance for kids to get onstage themselves!

Come join some of UCB’s best improvisers as they put on an all-ages comedy show so deeply appropriate, you can bring your kids to it! In fact, you SHOULD bring your kids to it! But wait… there’s more!

Not only will you get to see a great improv set from some of Los Angeles’s best performers, kids in the audience 5 and up will also get the opportunity to hop on the UCB stage and do some improv themselves (while the adults just try to hold on) in a fun, funny and supportive environment. What’s more wildly appropriate than that?

Hosted by Mae Tarica Fernie (age 7) as well as Deborah Tarica and Alex Fernie (who are much older).

With special guests: Nnamdi Ngwe, Isabella Escalante, Greg Tuculescu

shows.description: Chicago's longest running short-form improv show (founded in 1987) and the only comedy show in Chicago EVERYONE is welcome at - from age 8 to 80, our inclusive 'everyone is welcome' approach to comedy makes us perfect for patrons of all ages. Whether you're bringing your family, your co-workers, or a date - you are welcome, and you will laugh. ComedySportz is two teams of all-star improv comedians going head to head in comedy games, scenes and songs. YOU will vote on which team you liked the best and the teams will score points based on your applause. One of our world-famous referees will guide you through the whole show and may even ask for your help on stage. Every show ends in our incredible 6 THINGS game that is known throughout the world as 'the hardest game in all of improv'. It's fast. It's hilarious. It's appropriate for all ages. It's ComedySportz.

shows.description: "...countless laughs...whimsical homage to the illustrious author." -- Chicago Reader Improvised Jane Austen continues its entirely improvised tales of love and laughter this summer. Audiences will enjoy an evening with wit and heart in equal measure with an improvised rom-com for everyone, whether you love Austen or just like to laugh! Improvised Jane Austen currently performs Saturday nights at 6:00 pm at iO Theater and tickets are $20. "...[They] took it, owned it and created some really funny and touching moments....an evening of silliness and indulgence....make running amok look like delicious fun." -- PerformInk Chicago Join Improvised Jane Austen for the signature romantic comedy and social satire of the beloved author, improvised by Chicago's top comedic talent. Celebrate all things love, friendship, and Austen this Summer. “...Improvised Jane Austen is one of the strongest improv troupes in the city. They have the ability to use Austen’s 19th century wit and sarcasm and make it recognizable for a 21st-century audience." --Scapi Magazine Improvised Jane Austen is a comedic ensemble that creates unscripted performances using Jane Austen's tropes, themes, and language to create a satirical romantic comedy set in Regency-era England. Playing in Austen’s world, Improvised Jane Austen’s stories delight 21st century audiences with a modern sense and sensibility. The current cast of 20+ performers rotate weekly, creating a new ensemble for every show. Come for the humor, stay for the heart! Throughout the show’s run, Improvised Jane Austen has been Chicago Reader Recommended , named a PerformInk Critics’ Pick , voted Best sketch/improv troupe 2019 in the Reader’s Best of Chicago , and was featured on WTTW playlist , in Time Out , the Chicago Tribune and on a their list of what to do on Valentine’s Day , on WGN’s Daytime Chicago in 2024 and 2026 and on CBS News Chicago . Learn more: https://improvisedjaneausten.com/

shows.description:
Smokeshow takes over Saturday night with unhinged and unfiltered live sketch comedy, featuring UCB mainstays and LA’s top talent!

Smokeshow returns to UCB Theatre in Hollywood for a Saturday Night Sketch show, and this time, they’re bringing back their best and favorite sketches from their legendary Maude run and beyond. The Maude Night graduate sketch team takes over UCB Theatre with an explosive live sketch comedy show that’s unhinged, unfiltered, and unbelievably funny. This Greatest Hits set is a perfect night out whether you’re a longtime fan or discovering your new favorite comedy group. It’s the ideal pick if you’re hunting for a Saturday night comedy show in Los Angeles or just looking for something fun to do in Hollywood this weekend.

Members of the team have appeared in St. Denis Medical (NBC), America’s Got Talent (NBC), Ghostbusters: Afterlife (Sony Pictures), and Strays (Universal Pictures), with writing credits spanning A Little Late with Lilly Singh (NBC), the Sundance Film Festival, The AV Club, and the Hollywood Fringe Festival. Whether you’re a tourist looking for a date night idea in LA or a local comedy nerd searching for live comedy near you, Smokeshow delivers some of Hollywood’s best and most exciting comedians on one stage.

Smokeshow performs at UCB Theatre in Hollywood every other first Saturday. Formed in the 2024–25 Maude Night season, the team has quickly become one of LA’s most talked-about sketch comedy groups.

shows.description: The Improvised Shakespeare Company® proudly presents its critically-acclaimed, long-running hit show Improvised Shakespeare Chicago now in it’s 20th year! Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. Nothing has been planned out, rehearsed, or written. The dialogue is said for the first time, the characters are created as you watch, and if ever you're wondering where the story is going...so are they! You've never seen the Bard like this before! “There’s really nothing quite like it in the city of Chicago. Smart, sophisticated, downright hilarious.” -TimeOut Chicago “…the show channels Monty Python as often as the Bard, and frequently with sly-witted results.” -The Chicago Tribune “Consistently Hilarious” -The Chicago Reader “Staggeringly Brilliant” -TimeOut Chicago “Consistently funny…'Tis v'ry, v'ry good.” -The Chicago Tribune “Indisputably great improv, fueled by smart plot development, stage chemistry and recognizable characters.” -Centerstage Chicago “In short, outstanding.” -TimeOut Chicago Find out more at improvisedshakespeare.com _________________________ Additional option to include Improvised Shakespeare's featured cocktail, Hamlet , with your ticket. It includes Nolets Dry Gin, St-Germaine, Campari, orange juice, and garnished with an orange wedge. Best part? Gratuity is included. Got a Drink Add-on? Follow these steps: Show your ticket to the host and mention the drink add-on. Grab your token and place it on your table. Enjoy your drink as a server will bring it by shortly. Note: Valid ID is required for all alcohol service. No ID, no drink, no refunds.

shows.excerpt: A brutally honest comedy about keeping tiny humans alive when you are dying inside. Created and performed by playwright, comedian, and viral creator Brandon Ogborn, SAHD (Stay-At-Home Dad) is a brutally honest one-man show about what happens when someone who…
shows.description:
A brutally honest comedy about keeping tiny humans alive when you are dying inside.

Created and performed by playwright, comedian, and viral creator Brandon Ogborn, SAHD (Stay-At-Home Dad) is a brutally honest one-man show about what happens when someone who grew up homeschooled in a religious cult tries to become a normal stay-at-home dad. From navigating the daily chaos of raising small children to processing his father’s thirteen-year obsession with creating a Rush Limbaugh board game, carbon monoxide poisoning, and cosmic fire truck visits, Ogborn weaves together stories that are equal parts ridiculous and truly heartbreaking. Through deeply personal storytelling, he discovers that the people who drive us crazy are often the same ones who somehow keep us sane.

Created and performed by Brandon Ogborn

Directed by Karole Foreman

shows.description:
ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

• “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” -Out Magazine

• “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” -Vice Magazine

—

Written and performed by Katie Rae Horn. Directed by Brad Pike. Katie Rae Horn is a comedian, a clown, and a really good friend. She is the winner of Best Non-Stand Up Comedian in the Chicago Reader and can be found performing at The Second City, iO Theater, The Annoyance, and all around Chicago. Instagram: @kt_horn Brad Pike is a writer and performer from Plano, Texas. Based in Chicago, he has spent over a decade performing longform improv with his team, Devil's Daughter, primarily at iO Theater, where he is now the creative director. He recently appeared in Chicago Fire and his award-winning animated short, " Experience the World: The Train " was an official selection of the Chicago International Film Festival.

shows.description:
Veteran comedy TV writers take the audience’s suggestion of a show title, and, on the spot, develop a pilot for a brand new show.

In UCB’s Pilot Season, veteran comedy TV writers take the audience’s suggestion of a show title, and, on the spot, develop a pilot for a brand new show. It could be a sitcom, a prestige drama, or any number of different genres. Talented improvisers then take that pitch and bring it to life on stage.

In solidarity with ongoing efforts to improve diversity and representation in the industry, all proceeds from the show will go to the Entertainment Community Fund, which provides emergency financial assistance and supports underrepresented writers and actors.

Produced by Saleh Karaman & Chris De La Cruz

shows.description:
ASSSSCAT—UCB’s signature improv juggernaut—is a live improv comedy show in Los Angeles at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre. An all-star comedy show featuring comedians you know from SNL, Dropout, and the world of Film & Television doing improv inspired by true stories from a surprise celebrity guest. ASSSSCAT has played to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country.

What Is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians taking the stage with a surprise celebrity guest. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our “monologist “ shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestions. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world.

Previous celebrity guests include: Will Ferrell, Mark Hamill, Tina Fey, Charles Barkley, Don Cheadle, Elizabeth Banks, Aubrey Plaza, Kumail Nanjiani, Amy Poehler, Robin Williams and more.

Why See ASSSSCAT?

ASSSSCAT is one of the best improv comedy shows in Los Angeles. Each show is a one-of-a-kind live comedy experience. Whether you’re a longtime fan of UCB or searching for live comedy in LA for the first time, or looking for new exciting date ideas in LA, ASSSSCAT offers a chance to see the best comedians in LA at the top of their game, and don’t forget the surprise celebrity guest at every show! And don’t worry, if you can’t see the show live, we also offer a LIVESTREAM option for all performances!

shows.description:
An inclusive mic for all comedic formats and all comedic performers!

Hosted by Blumpkin (Zachary Clark, Jacqueline Blizzard, Evie Barenberg, Luke Maynus, Charlie Berger, Journee Nia Brown, Vincent Biello, Macy Mcgrail, Dean Blizzard, Bini Yamin, Melia Hagino)

BYOT (“Bring Your Own Thing”) is UCB’s open mic that welcomes everyone in the comedy community (that means you!) to “bring your own thing,” whatever that may be! Sketch, improv, stand-up, musical comedy, characters, meta-textual deconstructions or just screaming wildly at the audience – whatever you want!

Continuing the legacy of the original BYOT (“Bring Your Own Team”) from the old UCBEast, every 2nd and 4th Sunday night at 9pm, Blumpkin will welcome all to strut their wild stuff for a welcoming and laughing audience. Go nuts – it’s a comedy laboratory! There WILL be open beakers of toxic & poisonous chemicals all over everything.

RULES:
– Signups will be available on this Google Form and on Instagram (@byotmic) on Sundays at 2pm. If you miss the signup, feel free to come through anyway and we will try to get you on!
– Everyone will get 4 minutes, but improv teams get 5 minutes (wow). Feel free to do less time if you want too!
– No targeted hatred/bigotry will be tolerated.

FREE TO ATTEND, NO RESERVATION NEEDED FOR ENTRY!

—-

shows.title: The Punch-up with Beth Stelling
shows.excerpt: A good-natured stand-up open mic where Beth Stelling punches your jokes up (when possible) Hi! I'm comedian Beth Stelling. I headlined Omaha Comedy Festival a few years ago and they asked me to lead a stand-up workshop, which I don't…
shows.description:
A good-natured stand-up open mic where Beth Stelling punches your jokes up (when possible)

Hi! I’m comedian Beth Stelling. I headlined Omaha Comedy Festival a few years ago and they asked me to lead a stand-up workshop, which I don’t really [know how to] do. When considering what I could offer fellow comedians (novice or otherwise), I figured it was to listen and offer feedback in the form of a tag or punchline. So we did that on a Sunday morning with a really great group of varying levels of comedians and it was so fun!

Right now, I think things are feeling dark and roasting one another isn’t helping… therefore I offer you The Punch-up Mic!

It’s a stand-up open mic where you can bring:

• a bit that works and you love but want to make better
• a late night set you’re perfecting
• an idea you want to workout
• you want to try stand-up for the first time!

All ages that are over 18 and experience levels welcome! Let’s get loose.

I, Beth Stelling, have credits if you feel like you need that. I started stand-up in Chicago eighteen years ago and have been in mostly L.A. (Improv and Comedy Store Paid Regular) but a little bit of NYC (passed at The Cellar) as well. I’ve got specials on HBO Max, Netflix, Showtime and Comedy Central but I feel like a good amount of my stuff is ending up on YouTube. I’ve performed late night sets on Conan, Jimmy Kimmel Live, The Pete Holmes Show and Last Call with Carson Daly (I’m 40). I’ve done punch-up on countless comedy movies like Good Boys and some where I signed my right to a credit away for cold hard cash. I’ve written on television shows like Crashing, I Love You America with Sarah Silverman, The Last O.G., Rick and Morty, Another Period and Strange Planet.

—

Chad Damiani is on a mission.

Save comedy from cleverness. Or burn it all down.

Watch as he directs nine NYC comics through a perilous modern clown show – one that forces them to dig deep, give more and find solutions to impossible problems. shows.description:
World famous, fully improvised musical. “TRULY AMAZING! CRITICS’ PICK” – The New York Times

The world’s most popular completely improvised musical!

Baby Wants Candy is a critically acclaimed comedy ensemble with casts in Chicago, LA, NY and an international touring company.

The audience shouts out the title of a musical that has never been performed before. Baby Wants Candy then creates that musical on the spot. Everything is improvised- the story, the characters, the music played by the band and what we loving refer to as “choreography”- all made up on the spot. shows.title: The FREE WEDNESDAY SHOW feat Dumb John and Birdlady
shows.excerpt: ***This is a free show, but it is highly recommended to reserve your ticket here to guarantee entry.***** Regarded as one of Chicago's funniest and most promising improv groups of the last decade, Dumb John is proud to take the iO Stage with Bird...
shows.description: ***This is a free show, but it is highly recommended to reserve your ticket here to guarantee entry.***** Regarded as one of Chicago's funniest and most promising improv groups of the last decade, Dumb John is proud to take the iO Stage with Birdlady in a new weekly long form improv show. Both teams apply their high energy strain of improvisation to a bizarre cultural harvest of small town Americana influence and ephemera, using a single audience suggestion to inspire a piece of unhinged long form improv that propels diesel-soaked characters through fever dream karaoke scenes and down neon aisles of roadside antique marts; exploring the depravity and brilliance found at the heart of every moment. Take flight with two back to back original iO ensembles, Birdlady and Dumb John! Every Wednesday night at 7:30 (FREE), watch as they migrate toward their ultimate destination: hilarious long-form improvisation! It’ll be a HOOT! They’re so funny this show should be Ill-EAGLE! People can’t stop RAVEN about this show! DOORS: 7:00pm SHOW: 7:30pm Birdlady is: Ali Khan Alonso Ramirez Daryn Robinson Devin Henderson Erin Washington Justin Parlette Lauren Frost Ryan Nolan Dumb John is: Mike Geraghty Steve Plock Linda Orr Traycie Mcbee Follow our teams on Instagram at @birdlady.io & @dumbjohn

shows.title: Improv: The Play
shows.excerpt: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never ...
shows.description: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never given a script, and must improvise their way through the scene. The result is a totally original, never before seen piece of theater. It’s drama, it’s comedy, it’s everything that’s magical about theater and improvisation. Come watch this brand-new show at iO and see something you won’t see anywhere else in the city. Featuring: Alex Beard Heather Mari Elijah Sloan Lexi Putter Lucas Pollitzer Marino Korellis Montrez Hawkins Nikk Tetreault Ryan Bowman Shawna Seals Directed by: James Dugan Produced by: Cory Hardin

shows.description: Come check out one of Chicago's best longform improv teams, Three Actors Living in a Cave (Ollie Hobson, Mike Brunlieb, and Kyle Bethea) on Thursdays at 9:30pm, 8/20 - 10/8! Joined each week by Lerin (Lauren Frost and Erin Washington) and a rotating guest team! About Three Actors Once upon a time three poor cooks rode upon a huge wooden boat to sail around the world, but it did crash into a coral reef and all 800 aboard were drowned or stung to death except for the three poor cooks. They clung to a floating wardrobe trunk and washed upon the shore of a strange island. There they wandered for seven days and were bitten again and again by poisonous snakes. On the eighth day, tortured by painful fevers, they found refuge in a damp cave where they ate moss and acted out warped little scenarios for one another until they passed away. Their corpses were well preserved by the cool wet cave air and you can visit the island and look at their dead bodies, faces frozen in jest to this very day. shows.title: Blueprint
shows.excerpt: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected ...
shows.description: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected as we build something completely original, live, right before your eyes. Past forms have included: Improvised Severance - Guided by two internal "staff members," three performers are physically out of the room, while three others perform as their innies, and every 5 minutes, the two swapped. Can they make sense of their outies? and versa? Understudies - In a longform narrative, each player on stage knows that they will eventually understudy another player in the show. The lights change and they have to embody a different player, and each time the lights change, they can select another player to embody. Overachiever - Three 2-person monoscenes happen on stage, utilizing the same physical space, but taking place in categorically different spaces. They must navigate space atop of and around one another while keeping connection to their partner. Improvised Heist - Ocean's Eleven, eat your heart out! Our players hit the major plot points of a heist and improvise their way through - initial idea, building the team, planning the heist, executing, and the aftermath Blueprint is joined each week by a lab cast opening for the show with their own unique, original form. Directed by James Dugan Cast: James Dugan Avery Ford Molly Jones Allen Lucas Janelle Soulliere Ryan Bowman

shows.description:
A free musical improv jam.

Musical improv is improv with the added conventions of musical theatre, meaning that your improvised scenes turn to songs, and you make up all the sung lyrics and choreography along with the scene.

Whether you’ve never tried musical improv before, are a student studying musical improv, or are an established improviser who wants to try something new, this jam is a low-pressure FREE opportunity to do musical improv, joined by veterans of the form.

Please note, this is a jam, NOT a class, meaning we won’t be teaching the conventions of the form, we’ll just be playing sets! You are totally welcome to jump in regardless, but if that feels scary, Musical Improv 101 is a great place to start learning about this form!

Hosted by: Ryan Brookshire, Tara Copeland, Philip Labes, Greg Smith, Ashley Ward and Andrew Young

No reservations needed – just show up and jam!

shows.excerpt: Does it stand for "Thank God It's Friday" or "Thank God It's Funny"... we'll never know. But we do know it's improv every Friday @ 7pm! Buy Tickets
shows.description: DOORS: 6:30 PM SHOW: 7:00 PM Eris Deep Space (downstairs) "It's Friday night and the mood is right. Gonna have some fun, show you how it's done, TGIF". BCC is bringing back ABC's TGIF programming block Fridays at 7pm ET / 6 pm CT with Duchovny and Olestra. Does it stand for "Thank God It's Friday" or "Thank God It's Funny"... we'll never know. But it will be funny and it will be on Friday and we will thank god for both. Duchovny is a group of elite New York maniacs comprised of veteran improvisers, actors, and comedians who you've probably seen in TV, movies, and even the most coveted work of all, digital-only commercials that air before Youtube videos. ComedySportz is two teams of all-star improv comedians going head to head in comedy games, scenes and songs. YOU will vote on which team you liked the best and the teams will score points based on your applause. It's ComedySportz.

shows.description: The Improvised Shakespeare Company® proudly presents its critically-acclaimed, long-running hit show Improvised Shakespeare Chicago now in it’s 20th year! Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. Nothing has been planned out, rehearsed, or written. The dialogue is said for the first time, the characters are created as you watch, and if ever you're wondering where the story is going...so are they! You've never seen the Bard like this before! “There’s really nothing quite like it in the city of Chicago. Smart, sophisticated, downright hilarious.” -TimeOut Chicago “…the show channels Monty Python as often as the Bard, and frequently with sly-witted results.” -The Chicago Tribune “Consistently Hilarious” -The Chicago Reader “Staggeringly Brilliant” -TimeOut Chicago “Consistently funny…'Tis v'ry, v'ry good.” -The Chicago Tribune “Indisputably great improv, fueled by smart plot development, stage chemistry and recognizable characters.” -Centerstage Chicago “In short, outstanding.” -TimeOut Chicago Find out more at improvisedshakespeare.com _________________________ Additional option to include Improvised Shakespeare's featured cocktail, Hamlet , with your ticket. It includes Nolets Dry Gin, St-Germaine, Campari, orange juice, and garnished with an orange wedge. Best part? Gratuity is included. Got a Drink Add-on? Follow these steps: Show your ticket to the host and mention the drink add-on. Grab your token and place it on your table. Enjoy your drink as a server will bring it by shortly. shows.description:
ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

• “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” -Out Magazine

• “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” -Vice Magazine

shows.description: "...countless laughs...whimsical homage to the illustrious author." -- Chicago Reader Improvised Jane Austen continues its entirely improvised tales of love and laughter this summer. Audiences will enjoy an evening with wit and heart in equal measure with an improvised rom-com for everyone, whether you love Austen or just like to laugh! Improvised Jane Austen currently performs Saturday nights at 6:00 pm at iO Theater and tickets are $20. "...[They] took it, owned it and created some really funny and touching moments....an evening of silliness and indulgence....make running amok look like delicious fun." -- PerformInk Chicago Join Improvised Jane Austen for the signature romantic comedy and social satire of the beloved author, improvised by Chicago's top comedic talent. Celebrate all things love, friendship, and Austen this Summer. “...Improvised Jane Austen is one of the strongest improv troupes in the city. They have the ability to use Austen’s 19th century wit and sarcasm and make it recognizable for a 21st-century audience." --Scapi Magazine Improvised Jane Austen is a comedic ensemble that creates unscripted performances using Jane Austen's tropes, themes, and language to create a satirical romantic comedy set in Regency-era England. Playing in Austen’s world, Improvised Jane Austen’s stories delight 21st century audiences with a modern sense and sensibility. The current cast of 20+ performers rotate weekly, creating a new ensemble for every show. Come for the humor, stay for the heart! Throughout the show’s run, Improvised Jane Austen has been Chicago Reader Recommended , named a PerformInk Critics’ Pick , voted Best sketch/improv troupe 2019 in the Reader’s Best of Chicago , and was featured on WTTW playlist , in Time Out , the Chicago Tribune and on a their list of what to do on Valentine’s Day , on WGN’s Daytime Chicago in 2024 and 2026 and on CBS News Chicago . Learn more: https://improvisedjaneausten.com/

shows.description:
NYC’s funniest improv show brought to you by a group of top-tier psychopaths.

Have you ever had an encounter with a ghost? An alien? A kid you were babysitting who is maybe just spoiled BUT PERHAPS WAS ACTUALLY POSSESSED?! Each show, we let real audience encounters with the unexplained inspire a completely improvised fever dream, the likes of which has never been seen before, will never be seen again, and perhaps… shouldn’t be seen again because some of that stuff was deeply unwell. I mean don’t get me wrong, it was funny, but I really hope they’re in therapy.

This group of elite New York maniacs is composed of veteran improvisers, actors, and comedians who you’ve probably seen in TV, movies, and even the most coveted work of all, digital-only commercials that air before YouTube videos. Their collective credits include Girls, Russian Doll, The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel, What We Do in the Shadows, The Other Two, Dickinson, and getting paid to dress up as a slice of pizza at the New York Stock Exchange.

Featuring: Amanda Breen, James Dwyer, Lou Gonzalez, Patrick Keene, Yoni Lotan, Tami Sagher, Akmal Tajihan, and Sarah Grace Welbourn

shows.title: The Armando Diaz Experience
shows.description: The legendary show is reborn! Created in 1995 at the iO Theater in Chicago, The Armando Diaz Experience IS the longest running improv show EVER. A guest monologist takes a suggestion from the audience and shares true stories from their life. These stories are then brought to life by a rotating cast of improv all-stars, which take audiences on a high minded, exhilarating comedic joy ride that will leave mouths tired of smiling. And occasionally, just occasionally, the man with his name on the show will drop by for some fun. "The “Armando,” performed every Saturday, always begins with a monologue, and at a recent show it was about a connection made on the internet that led a decade later to a real-life relationship. The team of improvisers built patient scenes off this moving story, which made daring shifts in perspective, from the real world to secret worlds, inside and outside of bodies. There was a playfulness to the creativity, bold choices that verged on reckless that wouldn’t make the transition to a script." shows.description: The Improvised Shakespeare Company® proudly presents its critically-acclaimed, long-running hit show Improvised Shakespeare Chicago now in it’s 20th year! Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. Nothing has been planned out, rehearsed, or written. The dialogue is said for the first time, the characters are created as you watch, and if ever you're wondering where the story is going...so are they! You've never seen the Bard like this before! “There’s really nothing quite like it in the city of Chicago. Smart, sophisticated, downright hilarious.” -TimeOut Chicago “…the show channels Monty Python as often as the Bard, and frequently with sly-witted results.” -The Chicago Tribune “Consistently Hilarious” -The Chicago Reader “Staggeringly Brilliant” -TimeOut Chicago “Consistently funny…'Tis v'ry, v'ry good.” -The Chicago Tribune “Indisputably great improv, fueled by smart plot development, stage chemistry and recognizable characters.” -Centerstage Chicago “In short, outstanding.” -TimeOut Chicago Find out more at improvisedshakespeare.com _________________________ Additional option to include Improvised Shakespeare's featured cocktail, Hamlet , with your ticket. It includes Nolets Dry Gin, St-Germaine, Campari, orange juice, and garnished with an orange wedge. Best part? Gratuity is included. Got a Drink Add-on? Follow these steps: Show your ticket to the host and mention the drink add-on. Grab your token and place it on your table. Enjoy your drink as a server will bring it by shortly. Note: Valid ID is required for all alcohol service. No ID, no drink, no refunds.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. shows.excerpt: See a brand new sketch or solo show birthed right before your eyes that is auditioning for a run at the UCB theater. It's a show where we let sketch teams and solo performers try some shit out! Some will…
shows.description:
See a brand new sketch or solo show birthed right before your eyes that is auditioning for a run at the UCB theater.

It’s a show where we let sketch teams and solo performers try some shit out!

Some will be good, some will be bad but it will all be weird and new and that’s what makes it fun!

It’s experimental sketch at its finest! Come on, you know you need a spanking.

This Sunday, we have…

Hidden Gem: A poorly timed panic attack causes Viva to barricade herself into the only available bathroom at a party.

We’ve all done things we’ve regretted doing at parties, like hiding in someone else’s bathroom to work on ourselves emotionally. No? In her new solo show, comedian Viva Rose revisits core memories in an attempt to discover what exactly made her so mentally ill. Rest assured, Viva’s show is not needless trauma-dumping, it’s a lobotomy. In one hour of dark stand-up comedy and storytelling, Viva will fix her brain chemistry — and yours — once and for all. This show is waaaaaaay cheaper than seeing a therapist, and you won’t even need therapy by the end of it.

After a sold out run at the Hollywood Fringe, Viva’s bringing Hidden Gem to the UCB main stage. Described by many as a “must-see” and “[like] early Mike Birbiglia, but through a Gen Z lens,” Hidden Gem is for lovers of narrative stand-up comedy and anyone who misses seeing their friends in person, not just online. Viva performs stand-up comedy all over the country and was recently featured on Netflix is a Joke fest.

Written & performed by Viva Rose

Directed by Ben Ellerbrock

shows.description:
The Trial: An Improvised Court Experience

Finally, an improv show that will make you want to go to jury duty! “The Trial” improvises a tense courtroom trial right before your eyes — from dramatic opening statements to thrilling verdict.

The first half of the show is a “Spokane” form in the courtroom; we flash back-and-forth in time from the courtroom to the events pertinent to the trial, all the while “seeing” testimony, witnesses, and evidence along the way.

The second half of the show is a Monoscene taking place during deliberations as a jury decides the fate of the accused.

Can you handle the truth???

shows.description:
ASSSSCAT—UCB’s signature improv juggernaut—is a live improv comedy show in Los Angeles at the Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre. An all-star comedy show featuring comedians you know from SNL, Dropout, and the world of Film & Television doing improv inspired by true stories from a surprise celebrity guest. ASSSSCAT has played to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country.

What Is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians taking the stage with a surprise celebrity guest. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our “monologist “ shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestions. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world.

Previous celebrity guests include: Will Ferrell, Mark Hamill, Tina Fey, Charles Barkley, Don Cheadle, Elizabeth Banks, Aubrey Plaza, Kumail Nanjiani, Amy Poehler, Robin Williams and more.

Why See ASSSSCAT?

ASSSSCAT is one of the best improv comedy shows in Los Angeles. Each show is a one-of-a-kind live comedy experience. Whether you’re a longtime fan of UCB or searching for live comedy in LA for the first time, or looking for new exciting date ideas in LA, ASSSSCAT offers a chance to see the best comedians in LA at the top of their game, and don’t forget the surprise celebrity guest at every show! And don’t worry, if you can’t see the show live, we also offer a LIVESTREAM option for all performances!

• “The hardest we’ve laughed in a long, long time.” – Out Magazine
• “Among improv people today, the gold standard is a group called ASSSSCAT.” – Vice Magazine
• “Critics’ Pick” – Time Out Los Angeles

shows.description: Anything But Dragons fuses the best parts of tabletop roleplaying games, improv, and experiential theatre. Each night we create a brand new TTRPG using audience suggestions and the chaos of the dice. We collect 30 suggestions from you, roll two 30-sided dice, and that’s the name of our game. A Game Master and three actors get on their feet and bring the world to life while you, our Fatekeepers, steer the narrative and try to keep the party alive. Real dice! No plan! Anything goes! Anything But Dragons. Insta: @anythingbutdragons Discord: https://discord.gg/XmvP3d6tWr

shows.excerpt: Looking for a Stand-up Comedy Open Mic that’s a supportive room and always a good time? Look no further than the Ya'll Mic. Whether you’re a seasoned comic, an improvisor who’s always wanted to try standup, or you just decided that today’s
shows.description: Looking for a Stand-up Comedy Open Mic that’s a supportive room and always a good time? Look no further than the Ya'll Mic. Whether you’re a seasoned comic, an improvisor who’s always wanted to try standup, or you just decided that today’s the day for your first open mic (kudos) – The Ya'll Mic is a great venue to workshop your bits. The show is every Tuesday from 5:30pm – 7:30pm. Signup is online and the signup sheet is posted on Facebook & IG on Mondays. The list is emailed out a few hours before the show. Comics get 4 minutes of stage time (and a lifetime of memories.) While all are welcome, the room prioritizes BIPOC, LGBTQ+, and Femme comics. Come laugh with us!

shows.excerpt: All Out! is UCB’s newest LGBTQ+forward stand-up open mic for queer-identifying comics and allies! All Out! is UCB's brand new LGBTQ+ focussed monthly stand-up open mic here to cultivate a safe, supportive space for queer-identifying comics (and allies!) to take…
shows.description:
All Out! is UCB’s newest LGBTQ+forward stand-up open mic for queer-identifying comics and allies!

All Out! is UCB’s brand new LGBTQ+ focussed monthly stand-up open mic here to cultivate a safe, supportive space for queer-identifying comics (and allies!) to take risks, build community and have fun!

Come through every 3rd Tuesday to see some of L.A.’s funniest comics-on-the-rise as they try out new material, fine-tune their tight five and let those pride flags fly.

Comic sign-ups are in person on the day of lottery style, so arrive 5-10 minutes early to throw your name in the bucket for a 5 minute set (10 slots total).

We encourage everyone to stay for the entire show to celebrate and support each other, so as an added incentive one name will be drawn (from all comics remaining by show’s end) to get a juicy 10 minute set in next month’s show!

Hosted by Koschka Bahr

shows.description: DOORS: 6:30 PM SHOW: 7:00 PM Eris Mainstage Deeply beloved Brooklyn Comedy Collective performer Blaise Santi is turning 27, and there are only two things he’s ever wanted for his birthday: to host his very own late-night variety show, and for all his friends to be gathered in one room paying attention to him! Whether either of those will happen smoothly remains to be seen, but what we can guarantee is that in the span of one hour and change, there will be sketch comedy from Golfers, improv from Cast Party and Horse Girls, music from band leader Kyle de Camp, and MORE SURPRISES!! Line-Up: Blaise Santi (@blaisejoesanti) Kyle deCamp (@kyletdecamp) Grace Krick (@graceabigailalice) Eric Niemeyer (@_ericniemeyer_) Ren Ragsdale (@renragsdale) Golfers (@golferssketch) Cast Party (@castpartyimprov) Horse Girls (@horsegirlscomedy) Fine Print: Must be 21+ to attend. No outside alcohol is allowed in the space. There are 60 seats - first come, first serve - and then standing room up to capacity. All ticket sales are final - no refunds. If you must miss your show, email us at info@brooklyncc.com with at least 24 hours notice and we can transfer your tickets to any upcoming show at the BCC. Answers to most other questions can be found here . If show is sold out, limited tickets will be available at the door. If you (ticketholder) are not checked in at showtime, we may sell your ticket to the standby list. Comedy closure your ex will never give you.

A comedy show full of sketches, audience breakup stories, giveaways to help you bounce back, and PROOF that you won your last breakup. Hold that grudge and put on another coat of waterproof mascara, because we’re giving you the closure your ex never will!

Public Breakup hosts the monthly UCB Sketch Cagematch and their video sketches have been featured at Toronto Sketchfest and Philly Sketchfest. They have performed live at San Francisco Sketchfest, iO Fest, Montreal Sketchfest, and Burbank Comedy Festival (Best of the Fest Showcase). Members of Public Breakup can be seen in TV shows, national commercials, and on house teams at UCB and The Shared Experience. But they are most proud of being best friends with each other.

An open mic where comedians can push boundaries, try bold new ideas, and embrace the unpredictable.

The comedy laboratory where anything can happen!

Every Tuesday, Experimental Mic puts a different spin on the traditional open mic. Every show has its own theme, challenge, or format, so no two nights are the same.

One week, comedians might be doing crowd work. The next, they could be battling A.I in a joke battle, getting “analyzed” by therapists, or trying a brand-new experiment.

shows.title: The Drop: An Open Clown Rehearsal
shows.excerpt: Here’s your chance to see how a clown show is built from absolutely nothing. And it’s completely free! Clown Boss Chad Damiani is building a brand-new clown ensemble show. One that mixes modern clown with elements of improv, sketch and…
shows.description:
Here’s your chance to see how a clown show is built from absolutely nothing. And it’s completely free!

Clown Boss Chad Damiani is building a brand-new clown ensemble show. One that mixes modern clown with elements of improv, sketch and stand-up.

Every third Wednesday of the month from 12-2pm, he’s bringing together some of the best people from all these worlds to play together and explore the unknown – in the hopes of finding a fresh and unique one-hour format. In clown work, this devising process is made open to the public. We want an audience to see our failures and successes, adding to the sense of risk and allowing performers to experiment with different audience games.

Audience members can ask questions and participate in a talk-back at 2pm. See great artists take big risks and the discoveries that can happen when you make all the wrong choices.

shows.description: ***This is a free show, but it is highly recommended to reserve your ticket here to guarantee entry.***** Regarded as one of Chicago's funniest and most promising improv groups of the last decade, Dumb John is proud to take the iO Stage with Birdlady in a new weekly long form improv show. Both teams apply their high energy strain of improvisation to a bizarre cultural harvest of small town Americana influence and ephemera, using a single audience suggestion to inspire a piece of unhinged long form improv that propels diesel-soaked characters through fever dream karaoke scenes and down neon aisles of roadside antique marts; exploring the depravity and brilliance found at the heart of every moment. Take flight with two back to back original iO ensembles, Birdlady and Dumb John! Every Wednesday night at 7:30 (FREE), watch as they migrate toward their ultimate destination: hilarious long-form improvisation! It’ll be a HOOT! They’re so funny this show should be Ill-EAGLE! People can’t stop RAVEN about this show! DOORS: 7:00pm SHOW: 7:30pm Birdlady is: Ali Khan Alonso Ramirez Daryn Robinson Devin Henderson Erin Washington Justin Parlette Lauren Frost Ryan Nolan Dumb John is: Mike Geraghty Steve Plock Linda Orr Traycie Mcbee Follow our teams on Instagram at @birdlady.io & @dumbjohn

shows.title: CONNOR RATLIFF presents THE ACTING CLASS
shows.excerpt: A one-person improv show disguised as an acting class, from the creator of the Dead Eyes podcast. Professional actor (Widow's Bay, Bob's Burgers, “King Henry” in a recent State Farm ad) and award-winning podcaster (Dead Eyes) CONNOR RATLIFF is a…
shows.description:
A one-person improv show disguised as an acting class, from the creator of the Dead Eyes podcast.

Professional actor (Widow’s Bay, Bob’s Burgers, “King Henry” in a recent State Farm ad) and award-winning podcaster (Dead Eyes) CONNOR RATLIFF is a classically trained performer who graduated “with honours” from the prestigious Liverpool Institute For Performing Arts over a quarter of a century ago, making his professional debut on the stage of the Royal Court Theatre in London’s West End. During that same year, he also performed at Buckingham Palace for Queen Elizabeth II. In the decades that followed, he has accumulated numerous credits as a star of stage, screen and stream, appearing in multiple Netflix Original Films as well as content on CBS, NBC, FOX, TBS, Nickelodeon, TruTV, Home Box Office, Amazon Prime, Apple TV and the now-defunct comedy platforms, Go90 and Seeso.

But none of that matters now.

What matters now is CONNOR RATLIFF presents THE ACTING CLASS, an unending series of workshop performances where he will, before your very eyes, demonstrate what acting truly IS.

Each performance will be slightly interactive and completely improvised, with occasional opportunities for “students” to participate (from the safety of their position in the audience.)

[Sometimes, there will be a guest, and occasionally they will not be announced in advance. Previous “announced” guests include Jack Quaid, Zach Cherry, Patrick Wilson, James III, Jeff Hiller and Griffin Newman; “surprise” guests have included Meg Ryan and Rachel Zegler.]

Defiantly self-indulgent and beyond pointless, THE ACTING CLASS is your opportunity to witness the kind of greatness – only slightly appreciated by The Industry – that has kept Connor Ratliff steadily employed for nearly half of the past 10+ years.

Praise for Connor Ratliff:

“Connor Ratliff is a brilliant and funny comedic performer and actor.”
THE NEW YORKER

“An Improv Star.”

VANITY FAIR

“An Improv Ace.”

MEN’S JOURNAL

“Funny.”

THE F

shows.title: Improv: The Play
shows.excerpt: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never ...
shows.description: With the help of some of Chicago’s best actors, Improv: The Play is a new, hybrid version of long form improv happening only at the iO Theater. Each night, professional actors prepare a scene from a play. Their scene partners, however, are never given a script, and must improvise their way through the scene. The result is a totally original, never before seen piece of theater. It’s drama, it’s comedy, it’s everything that’s magical about theater and improvisation. Come watch this brand-new show at iO and see something you won’t see anywhere else in the city. Featuring: Alex Beard Heather Mari Elijah Sloan Lexi Putter Lucas Pollitzer Marino Korellis Montrez Hawkins Nikk Tetreault Ryan Bowman Shawna Seals Directed by: James Dugan Produced by: Cory Hardin

shows.description: If you’re looking for a date night, girls’ night out, or a mandatory work outing (that your staff will actually like) — Look no further! Fast, funny, and frothy, Thursday Night Improv is entirely improvised and features a different guest opener for veteran iO house team Creamboy every week. Every show is completely different, so you can keep coming back for more! Will you be the lucky audience member to receive the coveted title of Cream of the Week? Creamboy is made up of seasoned Chicago improvisers who play and teach all over the city (and country! And WORLD?!) which means this show is perfect for improv nerds, millennials who love Tina Fey, and even your cousin visiting from Kansas. Comedy so good you'll lick your lips and pat your belly. Mmmm so creamy! Get a taste of Creamboy on Instagram @ creamboy.io

shows.excerpt: Come check out one of Chicago's best longform improv teams, Three Actors Living in a Cave (Ollie Hobson, Mike Brunlieb, and Kyle Bethea) on Thursdays at 9:30pm, 8/20 - 10/8! Joined each week by Lerin (Lauren Frost and Erin Washington) and a rotati...
shows.description: Come check out one of Chicago's best longform improv teams, Three Actors Living in a Cave (Ollie Hobson, Mike Brunlieb, and Kyle Bethea) on Thursdays at 9:30pm, 8/20 - 10/8! Joined each week by Lerin (Lauren Frost and Erin Washington) and a rotating guest team! About Three Actors Once upon a time three poor cooks rode upon a huge wooden boat to sail around the world, but it did crash into a coral reef and all 800 aboard were drowned or stung to death except for the three poor cooks. They clung to a floating wardrobe trunk and washed upon the shore of a strange island. There they wandered for seven days and were bitten again and again by poisonous snakes. On the eighth day, tortured by painful fevers, they found refuge in a damp cave where they ate moss and acted out warped little scenarios for one another until they passed away. Their corpses were well preserved by the cool wet cave air and you can visit the island and look at their dead bodies, faces frozen in jest to this very day. shows.title: Blueprint
shows.excerpt: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected ...
shows.description: Blueprint is the kind of improv that keeps audiences AND players on their toes. Each week, a different cast member designs a bold new improv format that their fellow performers will learn about at the same time as the crowd. Expect the unexpected as we build something completely original, live, right before your eyes. Past forms have included: Improvised Severance - Guided by two internal "staff members," three performers are physically out of the room, while three others perform as their innies, and every 5 minutes, the two swapped. Can they make sense of their outies? and versa? Understudies - In a longform narrative, each player on stage knows that they will eventually understudy another player in the show. The lights change and they have to embody a different player, and each time the lights change, they can select another player to embody. Overachiever - Three 2-person monoscenes happen on stage, utilizing the same physical space, but taking place in categorically different spaces. They must navigate space atop of and around one another while keeping connection to their partner. Improvised Heist - Ocean's Eleven, eat your heart out! Our players hit the major plot points of a heist and improvise their way through - initial idea, building the team, planning the heist, executing, and the aftermath Blueprint is joined each week by a lab cast opening for the show with their own unique, original form. Directed by James Dugan Cast: James Dugan Avery Ford Molly Jones Allen Lucas Janelle Soulliere Ryan Bowman

shows.description:
ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

ComedySportz is two teams of all-star improv comedians going head to head in comedy games, scenes and songs. YOU will vote on which team you liked the best and the teams will score points based on your applause. One of our world-famous referees will guide you through the whole show and may even ask for your help on stage. Every show ends in our incredible 6 THINGS game that is known throughout the world as 'the hardest game in all of improv'. It's fast. It's hilarious. It's appropriate for all ages. Improvised Jane Austen currently performs Saturday nights at 6:00 pm at iO Theater and tickets are $20. "...[They] took it, owned it and created some really funny and touching moments....an evening of silliness and indulgence....make running amok look like delicious fun." -- PerformInk Chicago Join Improvised Jane Austen for the signature romantic comedy and social satire of the beloved author, improvised by Chicago's top comedic talent. Celebrate all things love, friendship, and Austen this Summer. “...Improvised Jane Austen is one of the strongest improv troupes in the city. They have the ability to use Austen’s 19th century wit and sarcasm and make it recognizable for a 21st-century audience." --Scapi Magazine Improvised Jane Austen is a comedic ensemble that creates unscripted performances using Jane Austen's tropes, themes, and language to create a satirical romantic comedy set in Regency-era England. Playing in Austen’s world, Improvised Jane Austen’s stories delight 21st century audiences with a modern sense and sensibility. The current cast of 20+ performers rotate weekly, creating a new ensemble for every show. Come for the humor, stay for the heart! Throughout the show’s run, Improvised Jane Austen has been Chicago Reader Recommended , named a PerformInk Critics’ Pick , voted Best sketch/improv troupe 2019 in the Reader’s Best of Chicago , and was featured on WTTW playlist , in Time Out , the Chicago Tribune and on a their list of what to do on Valentine’s Day , on WGN’s Daytime Chicago in 2024 and 2026 and on CBS News Chicago . shows.title: The Armando Diaz Experience
shows.description: The legendary show is reborn! Created in 1995 at the iO Theater in Chicago, The Armando Diaz Experience IS the longest running improv show EVER. A guest monologist takes a suggestion from the audience and shares true stories from their life. These stories are then brought to life by a rotating cast of improv all-stars, which take audiences on a high minded, exhilarating comedic joy ride that will leave mouths tired of smiling. And occasionally, just occasionally, the man with his name on the show will drop by for some fun. "The “Armando,” performed every Saturday, always begins with a monologue, and at a recent show it was about a connection made on the internet that led a decade later to a real-life relationship. The team of improvisers built patient scenes off this moving story, which made daring shifts in perspective, from the real world to secret worlds, inside and outside of bodies. There was a playfulness to the creativity, bold choices that verged on reckless that wouldn’t make the transition to a script." Join us for an evening of off-the-ruff comedy featuring the language and themes of William Shakespeare. Inspired by one audience suggestion (a title for a play that has yet to be written) the dazzling players create a brand-new Shakespearean masterpiece right before your eyes. shows.description:
ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show that has played to critical acclaim and sold out audiences across the country.

What is ASSSSCAT?

It starts with a group of improv comedians from film & TV taking the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, our monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories inspired by your suggestion. The improvisers then spin this monologue into a series of scenes that will show you why ASSSSCAT is one of the longest running improv shows in the world!

Previous NY monologists include: Mark Hamill, Alan Alda, Tina Fey, Keegan-Michael Key, Ellie Kemper, Kevin Bacon, Jessica Williams, Phoebe Robinson, Kathleen Turner, Paul Shaffer, Daniel Dae Kim, Conan O’Brien, and more!

Improvisers create scenes inspired by essays written about personal experiences and show that sometimes laughter really is the best medicine. Enjoying their 10+ year run at the Magnet Theater, YANA hopes to spread awareness and correct misconceptions about depression, all while providing an entertaining, fun, and safe space.
